data: ESA / European Commission Copernicus programme. Series 1-6 covers radar imaging, optical imaging, ocean monitoring, atmospheric chemistry, and altimetry.

Europe's flagship Earth-observation programme, operated by ESA on behalf of the European Commission's Copernicus environmental-monitoring service. Sentinel-1 (C-band SAR radar imaging), Sentinel-2 (multispectral optical at 10-60 m), Sentinel-3 (ocean + land), Sentinel-5P (atmospheric chemistry), Sentinel-6 (altimetry). All in sun-synchronous LEO. Free + open data policy — every Sentinel image is downloadable without licensing fees.
Only operational MEO commercial broadband — 20+ sats
Europe's civilian GNSS — ~30 sats, sub-metre positioning
Polar LEO comms — 66 operational sats +9 spares, GMDSS partner, global voice/data
Largest LEO broadband constellation — over 11,000 active satellites (as of October 2026)
First-gen LEO broadband — 648 sats in 12 polar planes

Europe's flagship Earth-observation programme — Sentinel-1 (C-band radar imaging), Sentinel-2 (multispectral optical), Sentinel-3 (ocean + land), Sentinel-5P (atmospheric chemistry), Sentinel-6 (altimetry). All sun-synchronous near 700 km. Free + open data policy.
